verses.text: Woe unto you, lawyers! For ye have taken away the key of knowledge, the fullness of the scriptures; ye enter not in yourselves into the kingdom; and those who were entering in, ye hindered.

title: JST, Luke 11:53. Compare Luke 11:52 The fulness of the scriptures is the key of knowledge.
